name: Strengthening and Weakening Tone
description: practise changing the strength of claims by choosing language that makes a statement weaker or stronger
author: IELTS Practice Team

questions.text:
Strengthen the tone:

The data shows that customers prefer ethical brands.

Wordbank: may / proves / genuinely / indicates

Strengthen the tone:

This shows that the marketing strategy is ineffective.

Wordbank: clearly / suggests / may / demonstrates

Strengthen the tone:

Transparency builds trust with customers.

Wordbank: may / significant / a degree of / always

Strengthen the tone:

We need to reduce waste.

Wordbank: should / must / consider / immediately

Weaken the tone:

The data shows that customers prefer ethical brands.

Wordbank: may / proves / genuinely / indicates

Weaken the tone:

This shows that the marketing strategy is ineffective.

Wordbank: clearly / suggests / may / demonstrates

Weaken the tone:

Transparency builds trust with customers.

Wordbank: may / significant / a degree of / always

Weaken the tone:

We need to reduce waste.

Wordbank: should / must / consider / immediately
